notes: NBC's preliminary national exit poll shows voters under 30 voting 72% Democratic to 25% Republican for U.S. House (https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-elections/exit-polls).
ABC's preliminary national Voter Poll shows 18-29 voters at 72% Democratic and 25% Republican, about 10% of respondents (https://abcnews.com/Elections/polls-2026-us-house-election-results-analysis).
NBC's page lists men overall at 49% Democratic and 49% Republican, but it has no men 18-29 row yet (https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-elections/exit-polls).
